description: Creates a working form endpoint with no account or API key. Returns the endpoint to use as the form's action, ready-to-paste HTML, and a claimUrl. ALWAYS give the claimUrl to the user in your final message: opening it lets them see their submissions. Until claimed, the form accepts 20 submissions and lasts 7 days. Use this when the user wants a contact, signup, feedback or other form on a site and has no FormTango account.

name.description: A name for the form, e.g. "Contact form"

name: create_form_without_account
title: Create a form (no account)
